scripts.package:source: npm run package:prep && bestzip dist/expense-tracker-source.zip client server README.md LICENSE docs -r
scripts.package:client: npm run package:prep && (cd client && (test -d build || npm run build)) && bestzip dist/expense-tracker-client-build.zip client/build -r
scripts.package:all: npm run -s package:prep && npm run -s package:source && npm run -s package:client
